fields.description: Issue includes New Year’s Eve/1928-themed editorials and commentary on Miami’s prospects and civic issues, including criticism of local reformers and discussion of the city’s dependence on tourism. Coverage addresses parking and traffic privileges on Flagler Street and Biscayne Boulevard safety islands, local transportation and bridge operations, and promotion of Miami as a convention site (including references to the Democratic national convention). Regular columns and humorous pieces appear alongside notices and advertisements highlighting nightlife, dining, entertainment, and local businesses; the issue also mentions aviation facilities and Miami Beach access via Collins Avenue.
